fixSummary: src/stores/scanStore.ts: gptTrusted (liveDecode + backgroundVerifyDeep) now requires codeType in [upc_a, ean_13, gtin_14] before trusting a bare GPT self-report as verified/auto-count. gradingRules.identityGrading: match = productName/identity semantically consistent with priorTruth; mismatch = wrong product family/identity; no_truth_available = Group A corpus rows graded against the corpus record itself (which IS the ground truth, since these are corpus_exact_barcode hits); outcome_only = no independent truth exists (case-pack/obscure codes with 'no public listing found' truth strings, or FNSKU truth that is explicitly 'seller-specific, not publicly resolvable') so only routing correctness (did NOT wrongly auto-count) is graded, never identity.
gradingRules.autoCountDefinition: status === 'verified' (per CLAUDE.md: autoAddDecodedProducts defaults true, so a route-returned 'verified' status auto-counts client-side; 'suggested' and 'needs_review' never auto-count).
gradingRules.autoCountCorrectness: An auto-counted (status=verified) row is a DEFECT if its identity is a mismatch vs priorTruth, or if priorTruth expects must-refuse/suggest-only and got auto-counted with a fabricated/wrong identity. It is CORRECT if identity matches or if the row is a Group A corpus hit (verified by construction).
gradingRules.postFixReevaluation: For every row with corroborationPath === 'gpt_self_report', the fixed gptTrusted gate is re-applied offline using each code's codeType (upc_a/ean_13/gtin_14 vs numeric_sku/alpha_sku) to determine whether commit 5d810d4 changes its outcome from verified to needs_review.

codes.adjudicationNote: THE HEADLINE FINDING. A 4-digit vendor part number (codeType numeric_sku, no public barcode structure) was auto-verified with a fabricated identity via GPT's self-report alone, with no independent app-verification (exactCodeEvidenceVerifiedByApp was honestly false, but the store's separate gptTrusted branch auto-counted anyway). Root cause: src/stores/scanStore.ts's gptTrusted branch trusted any gpt_self_report+verified+confidence>=0.8 result regardless of code shape. Fix (commit 5d810d46b7b3a8957851b4c0c2860430b54c7aa6, reviewed+approved, TDD red/green proven, 12/12 tests pass) adds a public-barcode-shape requirement (codeType in [upc_a, ean_13, gtin_14]) as the first conjunct of gptTrusted in both liveDecode and backgroundVerifyDeep. Re-applying the fixed gate to this row's recorded codeType (numeric_sku, 4 digits, fails the new gate) confirms: post-fix this row would settle at needs_review, NOT auto-count. Defect closed for this class.
